name: Manas Kaul
description: I am a Senior Software Engineer (Full-Stack) specializing in architecting distributed event-driven systems, microservices, and high-availability cloud infrastructure. With deep expertise across Java, Spring Boot, Golang, and Kafka, I thrive on building resilient, scalable platforms that process millions of events daily.

projects.name: Data Platform Interface
description: Contributing to Golang-based, GraphQL interface abstractions for core credit card APIs, enabling low-latency and high-throughput access while decoupling consumers from underlying service integrations.
Developing and optimizing high-throughput services handling 8,000+ RPS with sub-second latency, supporting performance-critical credit card workflows at scale.
Leading a team of 4 engineers in delivering and supporting production systems serving tens of thousands of MAUs, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and execution.

projects.name: Golden Copy Data Source
description: Architected and implemented a distributed event processing platform (PostgreSQL CDC, Kafka, stateless consumer microservices) processing 10M+ events/day with under 1s end-to-end delivery SLA.

Designed authoritative event-sourcing model backed by PostgreSQL (ACID-compliant) with Kafka-based propagation, eliminating dependency on external caching layers and ensuring strong consistency under retries and failures.
Led schema design for 500+ attributes per event, introducing versioned schema strategy and extensible data modeling to support high-throughput OLTP writes.
Built a real-time rule evaluation engine supporting thousands of user-defined filters with under 75ms matching latency, enabling personalized event delivery at scale.
Authored low-level design (LLD) and drove implementation across cross-functional stakeholders (data, infra, consumer teams), defining API contracts adopted by downstream services.
Owned performance tuning and capacity planning, benchmarking throughput (~7000 events/min sustained) and identifying bottlenecks across database writes and consumer lag.
Explored integration of AI-assisted agentic workflows (code generation, analysis, and automation) to improve developer efficiency, testing and code reliability.

projects.name: Electronic Affirmation Router
description: Designed and implemented multi-venue trade routing flow across 10+ microservices deployed on Kubernetes in JPMC private cloud, improving routing latency by 40% across complex trade setups.
Contributed to architecture handling ~1000 trades/day with daily notional value exceeding $200M, ensuring high reliability and accurate downstream settlement workflows.
Improved observability by standardizing structured logging, health checks, and alerting pipelines across services, reducing incident response time by 50% and improving SLA adherence.
Supported 99.99% uptime through resilient service design, graceful failure handling, and production issue triage in a globally distributed environment.

projects.name: Equipment Licensing and Location Management (ELLM)
description: End-to-end design and delivery, driving architecture decisions and production rollout adopted across multiple regions.
Architected backend services using Spring Boot with REST APIs and relational data modeling, supporting regulatory workflows that contributed to $20M+ annual revenue enablement.
Led migration from legacy on-prem infrastructure to cloud-native deployment, decommissioning legacy systems.
Designed and implemented micro-frontend architecture (Angular + TypeScript, Module Federation) enabling independent deployments and reducing release cycles by 30%.

subsection.heading: DA-IICT, Gujarat
description: Completed rigorous coursework with a strong focus on data structures, distributed systems, and modern software engineering architecture.
